text: I'm less anxious at work and more confident in general. I don't need constant reassurance anymore, which has made me feel much more stable and grown up. I also enjoy my weekends more because I'm not dreading Monday.

Ich bin insgesamt ruhiger und zufriedener. Ich habe weniger Angst vor der Zukunft und kann die Gegenwart mehr genießen. Ich habe auch gemerkt, dass ich offener für neue Menschen geworden bin, was mir in der neuen Stadt sehr geholfen hat, Anschluss zu finden.
Nothing either

I feel more at peace and at home in myself. My anxiety, which was always connected to the visa situation and the feeling of not belonging, has gone down a lot. I'm also more open to connecting with people here. I used to keep to myself because I thought I might have to leave anyway. Now I've made real friends and I feel part of a community. I'm grateful for my life here, whatever happens in the future, and I feel a lot of love for the people I've met.
Ich gehe besser mit mir um und habe dadurch weniger Phasen, in denen es mir richtig schlecht geht. Ich verstehe besser, warum ich mich bei Stress selbst vernachlässige, und kann gegensteuern.

The experience improved my mental health more than anything else I've tried. I had been depressed for about two years, mostly because I felt like a failure. I had lost my job, my relationship ended, and I'd moved back to my hometown. I felt like everyone was judging me. During the experience I felt such love and acceptance for myself, exactly as I was, broken and imperfect. I cried for hours. It was like I finally put down a heavy backpack I'd been carrying for years. Since then the depression has lifted. Not overnight, but steadily. I'm kinder to myself, and I've started to rebuild my life in a way that feels authentic to me instead of trying to impress anyone. I'm more open to different paths, and I've discovered I love working with my hands. I'm training as a carpenter now and I'm happier than I've been in years.
A bit happier
Ich bin gelassener und optimistischer geworden. Ich habe weniger Grübelphasen und schlafe besser. Ich genieße die guten Zeiten bewusster, weil ich weiß, dass alles vergänglich ist.

I'm more in tune with my body, and I can see how my mental and physical health are connected. My anxiety is lower because I catch the stress early and take care of it. I've had fewer stomach issues too. I feel healthier overall, and I'm grateful for my body in a way I never was before.
I'm more accepting of myself and less anxious. I'm happier with my life as it is.

Ich fühle mich selbstbewusster und psychisch stabiler. Ich habe gelernt, für mich einzustehen, und das hat meine Stimmung und mein Selbstwertgefühl verbessert. Ich bin auch offener anderen Meinungen gegenüber, weil ich mich nicht mehr so schnell angegriffen fühle.
I feel more connected to nature and I love being outside, which makes me happy, but I wouldn't say my mental health has changed. It was good before and it's good now.

My anxiety has improved a lot since I've broken the cycle of avoidance. I'm less depressed too, because I'm not constantly feeling guilty about all the things I haven't done. I feel more capable and more in control of my life. Understanding the loop I was stuck in has been the key for me. I also feel more grateful for the progress I've made, I'm proud of myself, which I wasn't before.

Ich bin offener für Neues geworden und habe weniger Angst vor dem Unbekannten. Das hat mein Leben bereichert, ich habe neue Hobbys angefangen und neue Freunde gefunden. Insgesamt geht es mir psychisch besser.
I'm more aware of my emotions and how they affect others. I feel less guilty and more in control of my moods.
I'm a happier and more relaxed parent. I enjoy my kids so much more now, instead of just trying to get through the day. I feel so much love for them and I'm less hard on myself when I make mistakes.
Ich bin sensibler geworden, das ist manchmal schön, weil ich mehr fühle, aber manchmal auch anstrengend. Ich würde nicht sagen, dass es mir insgesamt besser oder schlechter geht.
I'm more trusting and optimistic. My depression is better and I appreciate life more. I've also become more open to spiritual ideas, which give me comfort.

My mental health has improved a lot since the experience, mainly because I'm not constantly triggered by my ex-husband anymore. I used to feel anxious and angry most of the time, and I had nightmares about our marriage. Now I feel much more at peace. I also have more love and compassion, for myself, for my kids, and even for him. I didn't think that was possible after everything that happened. I'm grateful that my kids have a calmer mother now. I've also become more open to dating again, which I swore I'd never do.
Ich schlafe besser und bin weniger ängstlich. Meine Stimmung ist insgesamt stabiler.
I feel more connected to people and more understood. That has helped my mental health a lot, I used to feel quite isolated. I'm also more open to other people's perspectives and less judgemental.
Calmer mind, better sleep, happier

Ich bin psychisch gesünder, seit ich meinen Selbstwert nicht mehr nur über die Arbeit definiere. Ich hatte vor der Erfahrung einen Burnout und war lange krankgeschrieben. Heute habe ich ein ausgewogeneres Leben mit Hobbys, Freunden und Zeit für mich. Ich bin dankbarer für die Dinge, die nichts mit Leistung zu tun haben, und genieße sie mehr. Ich verstehe auch besser, warum ich so lange so viel gearbeitet habe: Ich wollte Anerkennung, die ich als Kind nicht bekommen habe.
I'm less anxious and less depressed. Life feels easier.
No impact. I was hoping it would help with my depression but it didn't really change anything. Maybe a week or two of feeling a bit better and then back to normal.

Ich habe alte Verletzungen verarbeiten können und bin dadurch innerlich ruhiger geworden. Ich habe weniger Albträume und fühle mich sicherer. Ich verstehe besser, warum ich so empfindlich auf Kritik reagiert habe.
Less anxious, more balanced. Better at controlling my emotions.

I feel so much more loved and supported in my relationship, and that has made a huge difference to my mental health. I used to feel lonely even with my partner, and now I feel like we're truly together. I'm happier and more secure, and I'm grateful every day for what we have.
Ich bin weniger gestresst und kann mich besser entspannen. Ich fühle mich ausgeglichener.

I'm more curious and open to life. I used to be quite anxious and closed off, and now I'm more willing to try new things and meet new people. I feel happier and more alive. I also see challenges as opportunities, which has changed my whole outlook.
It made me more paranoid and anxious, and for a while I had trouble trusting people. I'm in therapy now and it's slowly getting better, but it's been a hard couple of years.

Ich fühle mich weniger allein und habe mehr Vertrauen in meine Freunde. Das hat mir psychisch sehr geholfen, ich bin weniger niedergeschlagen und habe mehr Freude am Leben. Ich spüre auch mehr Liebe und Verbundenheit mit den Menschen um mich herum.

I'm much less anxious about things I can't control. I used to worry constantly, and now I'm more relaxed and present. I enjoy my life more, and I appreciate what I have instead of always worrying about losing it.
More stable and self-aware

Ich habe eine innere Ruhe gefunden, die ich vorher nicht kannte. Das hat meine psychische Gesundheit sehr verbessert. Ich bin weniger ängstlich und weniger getrieben. Ich habe auch das Gefühl, dass ich mehr Liebe in mir trage, für mich selbst und für andere. Ich bin dankbarer für die kleinen Momente des Glücks im Alltag und kann sie mehr genießen.
I'm more hopeful and optimistic about the future, and less depressed about the past.
I'm more resilient and less anxious. I feel like I can handle whatever life throws at me, and that has made me much happier. I'm also more open to change.
Kein großer Unterschied
I'm less afraid of my emotions and that has helped my anxiety and depression. I feel more whole.

Having clarity about my values has improved my mental health a lot. I'm less anxious because I know what I want, and I'm less depressed because I'm living in line with what matters to me. I feel more fulfilled and more grateful for my family and my creative work. I've also become more open and honest with people about who I am.
